operations.title: Inspect PDF
operations.summary: Read page, security, form, signature-marker, active-content, and rewrite-readiness evidence without changing the file.

operations.title: Compare PDFs
operations.summary: Render two PDFs and produce a self-contained gallery with expected, actual, and highlighted page differences.

operations.title: Merge PDFs
operations.summary: Combine two to ten PDFs in the selected order and download a separate merged document plus operation evidence.

operations.title: Split PDF
operations.summary: Create consecutive PDF parts with a selected page count and download the results together as a ZIP archive.

operations.title: Extract PDF pages
operations.summary: Create a new PDF from one-based page selections such as 1-3,5,last while leaving the source unchanged.

operations.title: Delete PDF pages
operations.summary: Create a separate PDF without selected pages after explicit confirmation; the source file is never changed.

operations.title: Reorder PDF pages
operations.summary: Create a new PDF with every source page exactly once in the supplied one-based order.

operations.title: Rotate PDF pages
operations.summary: Rotate selected pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees and download a separate PDF.

operations.title: Optimize PDF
operations.summary: Apply deterministic lossless compression, deduplication, or Fast Web View without rasterizing pages.

operations.title: Protect PDF
operations.summary: Encrypt a PDF with AES-256 Standard security and return preservation evidence with the protected copy.

operations.title: Unlock PDF
operations.summary: Remove Standard password security with the owner password and download a separate unprotected copy.

operations.title: Redact PDF text
operations.summary: Remove literal text matches and verify the rewritten content, encoded strings, and decoded streams before download.

browserConversions.title: PDF to DOCX
browserConversions.summary: Import PDF logical content into an editable Word document with diagnostics.

browserConversions.title: PDF to XLSX
browserConversions.summary: Import detected PDF tables into an editable workbook with diagnostics.

browserConversions.title: PDF to PPTX
browserConversions.summary: Reconstruct supported PDF content as native slide objects, or select explicit visual, hybrid, and tables-only projections with diagnostics.

browserConversions.title: PDF to HTML
browserConversions.summary: Project PDF logical content into reviewable HTML.
